name: Marker Headline
description: A headline with a phrase marked by a sweep of colour, on a field of fine dots that turn water blue under the pointer.

props.name: dotColor
props.description: Colour of the resting dots. Any CSS colour or token. The grid fades out towards the edges.

props.name: activeColor
props.description: Colour of the dots inside the circle around the pointer.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the circle around the pointer, in pixels. Its edge is soft.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the container. Lay out its content here. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: The phrase to mark. It wraps like ordinary text, and the wash follows it from line to line.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds after the phrase comes into view before the wash starts.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the wash takes to sweep from the first letter to the last. Under reduced motion it is shown at once.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the wash, or a list of colours blended from left to right.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the mark element. Other props are passed through.
